meta.name: switch-clients
meta.description: Switch between existing customer engagements and triage competing needs. Use when context switching causes confusion; requires engagement records and preserves one client per write.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你在多个客户项目之间来回切换,理清谁先谁后,不再搞混。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你同时服务好几个客户,常在项目间切换而乱了头绪。
copy.tagline_en: Switch between client engagements and sort competing priorities without mixing them up.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several client engagements and keep losing track when switching.

howto.what: 它帮你在已有的客户合作之间切换，梳理相互冲突的需求。它读取本地合作记录和已脱敏的数据包，一次写入只保留一个客户；记录缺失时如实报告，不凭空编造客户组合。
howto.when: 当上下文切换造成混乱、需要在已有客户合作之间来回切换时触发；前提是已有合作记录。若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前的脱敏数据包和范围，不重新开始。

say.text: 切换到 A 客户，接着上次的进度继续。
say.note: 载入该客户已有的合作记录。

say.text: 这两个客户的待办冲突了，帮我排优先级。
B 客户的记录没找到，告诉我缺哪些。
say.note: 把缺失记录如实报告为限制。

howto.what_en: It switches between your existing customer engagements and triages competing needs. It reads local engagement records and sanitized packets, keeps one client per write, and reports missing records honestly instead of inventing a portfolio.
howto.when_en: Triggers when context switching causes confusion and you need to move between existing customer engagements; engagement records are required. If called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Switch to client A and pick up where we left off.
These two clients' to-dos conflict - rank them for me.
Client B's record is missing - tell me what's absent.
say_en.note: Reports the gap as a limitation.
